What is FDP Value?

Values as of 2026-10-21

The FDP Value Scale

FDP Value is Fantasy Draft Pros' own dynasty player valuation system. Every player is assigned a value from 0 to 9,999 based on their dynasty fantasy football trade worth. Higher value = greater dynasty trade value.

What Determines FDP Value?

  • Base Valuation — Market-informed base value or position-rank decay model
  • Age & Dynasty Bonus — Youth bonus for pre-prime players, decline for post-prime
  • Superflex — QB values boosted in SF leagues
  • Scoring Format — Standard, Half PPR, and PPR affect positional values
  • TE Premium — TE values boosted when TEP is enabled
  • IDP Mode — DL, LB, DB values boosted when IDP is on

Rankings

Players are ranked by FDP Value. The highest value is Overall Rank #1. Position Rank determines Tier (Tier 1 = elite, Tier 5 = borderline starter).
